verdict.rationale: Formant provides data export via the Cloud SDK for querying/collecting telemetry (formant-docs-3, formant-docs-27) and a commands mechanism that can trigger scripts or actions on robots (formant-docs-4, formant-docs-9, formant-docs-29), which could theoretically be used to push a retrained model or trigger redeployment. However, there is no explicit documentation of a model-training integration or a dedicated 'deploy model to fleet' feature — the closest is generic 'AI assistant' and 'ML-driven task recommendations' language which is not about custom model training/deployment. Missing for 10: explicit model training pipeline integration, a documented model artifact deployment/update mechanism, and evidence of round-tripping trained models back onto devices.
